name: Intelligence
caption: Intelligence

configuration.description: prompt = a language model answers the prompt with text (output answer). classify = TypeSafe Jev answers all questions about input in ONE request; every question has its own outputs. The editor shows them as "Write an answer to a prompt" / "Answer questions about a text".

Code of an AI provider profile of the AutoFlow Intelligence Setup. Empty = the default language model profile (prompt) / the first TypeSafe profile (classify). The profile must be of the mode's kind (TypeSafe for classify, a language model otherwise) - publishing refuses another kind or an unknown code.
mode prompt: what the model should do. SmartText – {{…}} values of the flow are filled in before the call. Only stored for mode prompt.
mode prompt only: rows { type, reference, filename, contentBase64 } exactly like Send Email. Each resolved file is sent with the prompt: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP images and PDF, at most 20 MB together.
"Reference" (default) or "Inline", as in Send Email.
Reference rows: {{selector}} to AutoFlow Document reference(s) (table 5564415), an array or iterator of them, or name[N].
Inline rows: file name incl. extension. SmartText.
Inline rows: base64 content. SmartText. The type is read from the content's first bytes.
mode classify: the text every question is about (sent once as state.input). SmartText. Put everything the questions need into it, with labels, e.g. "Vendor: {{…}}\nText: {{…}}".
mode classify: 1 to 32 rows { id, type, instructions, answers, allowNone, answersFrom, list, listAnswer, listDescription }.
Name in later steps: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 19 characters, unique. It names the outputs (<id>, <id>_confidence, rating also <id>_level).
choice = pick one answer from answers; yesno = yes or no; rating = place the input on the levels in answers (lowest first).
The question itself, e.g. "What kind of document is this?". SmartText.
choice with answersFrom fixed: the possible answers (2–255). rating: the levels, lowest first (2–10). Not stored for yesno or a choice from a list. Rows { value, description }.
The answer / level name, unique per question. This is what <id> returns – use the wording later steps compare with, e.g. invoice.
Optional: when to pick this answer / what the level means. Helps the model; without it the answer is judged by its wording.

choice only, default true: when none of the answers fits, <id> is "none" (a separate fit question is asked in the same request). Switch off only when the answers surely cover every input; an answer may then not be called none.
choice only. fixed = the answers are typed into answers. list = the answers are read from a list of an earlier step every time the flow runs (list, listAnswer, listDescription).
answersFrom list: the list as a braced selector, records or values, e.g. {{FindProjects_results}}. Stored unresolved; read at run time like the Selection task's input.

answersFrom list: SmartText of one entry that is the answer, using the list's own name and the SmartField name of the field (no trailing dot), e.g. {{FindProjects_results.No}}. Empty = a record's primary key (or a value list's value).
answersFrom list, optional: SmartText of one entry that says when to pick it, e.g. {{FindProjects_results.Description}}. Needs listAnswer.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.when: mode prompt: the model's text answer

outputs.name: <id>
outputs.when: mode classify, one per question: choice → the chosen answer's value (for a list: the entry's listAnswer), or none when allowNone and no answer fits or the list is empty; yesno → true / false; rating → the value of the most likely level

outputs.name: <id>_level
outputs.when: rating questions: the number of the most likely level, 1 = the first (lowest) level

outputs.name: <id>_confidence
outputs.when: every classify question: how sure the answer is, a whole number 0–100 (yesno: of the given answer, not of yes)

rules.check: mode must be prompt or classify
rules.message: Choose what Intelligence should do: write an answer to a prompt, or answer questions.

rules.check: mode prompt: prompt must not be empty
rules.message: Enter the prompt.

rules.check: mode classify: input must not be empty
rules.message: Enter the text Intelligence should look at.

rules.check: mode classify: at least one question
rules.message: Add at least one question.

rules.check: mode classify: at most 32 questions; put more into a second Intelligence step
rules.message: One step answers at most %1 questions. Ask further questions in a second Intelligence step.

rules.check: questions[].id not empty
rules.message: Question %1: enter a name for later steps.

rules.check: questions[].id: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 19 characters
rules.message: Question %1: the name '%2' may only use letters, digits and _, must start with a letter and have at most %3 characters.

rules.check: questions[].id unique
rules.message: Questions %1 and %2 have the same name '%3'. Give each question its own name.

rules.check: no output name twice (e.g. a question named a_confidence next to a question a)
rules.message: Question %1: the name '%2' is already used by a result of question %3. Choose another name.

rules.check: questions[].type is choice, yesno or rating
rules.message: Question %1: choose how Intelligence should answer – one of a list, yes or no, or a rating.

rules.check: questions[].instructions not empty
rules.message: Question %1: enter the question.

rules.check: choice: 2 to 255 non-empty answers
rules.message: Question %1: enter at least two possible answers. / Question %1: a list takes at most %2 answers.

rules.check: rating: 2 to 10 non-empty levels
rules.message: Question %1: a rating needs 2 to %2 levels.

rules.check: answer values unique per question
rules.message: Question %1: the answer '%2' is listed twice.

rules.check: choice with allowNone: no answer may be called none
rules.message: Question %1: 'none' is already the answer when nothing fits. Remove it from the list, or switch off "Answer none when no answer fits".

rules.check: choice with answersFrom list: list not empty
rules.message: Question %1: pick the list the answers come from.

rules.check: answersFrom list: listDescription needs listAnswer
rules.message: Question %1: say which field of the list is the answer, or leave "When to pick it" empty too.

rules.check: profile exists and is of the mode's kind (wrapped: The Intelligence step '%1': …)
rules.message: The profile %1 does not exist. / The profile %1 is a language model profile. Answering questions needs a TypeSafe profile. / The profile %1 is a TypeSafe profile. Writing an answer needs a language model profile.

rules.check: mode classify takes no attachments yet
rules.message: Answering questions does not read files yet: images follow in a later release. Only a prompt reads files for now.

rules.check: mode prompt needs Intelligence switched on and a language model profile (wrapped: The Intelligence step '%1': …)
rules.message: the prompt mode needs Intelligence switched on and a language model profile.

rules.check: mode classify needs Intelligence switched on and a TypeSafe profile
rules.message: the classify mode needs Intelligence switched on and a TypeSafe profile.

rules.check: the trigger runs while the user works on the record (record created/modified interactive, document released/posted/reopened, page opened/closed, PDF printed, report file name, SubFlow): the user waits for the answer
rules.message: The Intelligence step '%1' runs while the user works on the record: the user waits until the model has answered (up to the timeout of the AutoFlow Intelligence Setup).

rules.check: answersFrom list: the list is empty at run time and allowNone is off (with allowNone the question answers none without asking)
rules.message: Question %1: the list %2 is empty, so there is nothing to choose from. To answer "none" instead, switch on "Answer none when no answer fits".

rules.check: answersFrom list: more than 255 entries at run time
rules.message: Question %1: the list %2 has %3 entries; a question can choose from at most %4.

rules.check: answersFrom list: the list has entries but listAnswer resolves for none of them (an unresolvable SmartField stays a {{token}} and counts as no answer)
rules.message: Question %1: the list %2 has %3 entries, but "Answer from each entry" (%4) gives no answer for any of them. Pick the field again with the { } button.

rules.check: an attachment is no PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image or PDF
rules.message: Intelligence cannot read the attachment '%1': only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images and PDF files are supported.

rules.check: attachments together over 20 MB
rules.message: The attachments are too large for one request (%1 MB, at most %2 MB).

rules.check: the answer hit the profile's max output tokens
rules.message: The answer was cut off at %1 output tokens. Raise "Max. Output Tokens" on provider profile %2, or ask for a shorter answer.

rules.check: the model answered with no text
rules.message: The model gave an empty answer.

rules.check: profile is of the other kind
rules.message: Profile %1 is a TypeSafe classification profile; the prompt mode needs a language model profile.

notes: Prefer ONE classify step with many questions over several steps: the input is sent once, each extra question costs only its own tokens.

To choose among records of the flow (e.g. which of the customer's projects an e-mail is about), use a choice with answersFrom list: a Find Records step before, list = {{FindProjects_results}}, listAnswer = {{FindProjects_results.No}}, listDescription = {{FindProjects_results.Description}}. The answer is the entry's No.; look the record up again with Find Records if later steps need it.
Branch on a choice with a Case step on {{<slug>_<id>}} (one edge per answer, plus none), or a Decision step. A yesno is true / false. A rating: compare {{<slug>_<id>_level}} as a number, e.g. >= 2.
For risky actions also check {{<slug>_<id>_confidence}}, e.g. >= 80.
Each run is logged as a session (AutoFlow Intelligence Setup → Sessions); the execution log line names the session no. A failed run fails the step.
The prompt answer is text. When later steps need structured data, ask for JSON in the prompt and read it with a Parser step.
The input and attachments go to the provider configured in the profile.
